description: This Java class defines a ViewHolder for displaying a note with only a title in a grid layout within an Android application. It manages UI binding, styling, and interaction handling for note items.

classes.name: NoteViewGridHolderOnlyTitle
classes.description: A ViewHolder class for displaying a note with only a title in a grid layout, supporting styling and binding of note data.

methods.name: NoteViewGridHolderOnlyTitle
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewHolder with binding, click listener, and styling options.

methods.name: showSwipe
methods.description: Throws an exception as swipe actions are not supported for this ViewHolder.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds note data to the view, including status, favorite, and searchable content, and applies styling.

methods.name: getNoteSwipeable
methods.description: Returns null, indicating this view does not support swipe actions.
